attempts.exactPrompt:
Create exactly one full-body Summonlab combat chibi derived only from the supplied verified summon portrait. Canvas 1024 x 1536. Use a clearly oversized adult head, compact torso, and shortened legs; never render a 3.5-head, 4-head, or tall-miniature figure. Preserve relative body widths without generic inflation of the body. Use a grounded ready-idle three-quarter pose, both empty hands and both feet completely visible, with a generous safe margin and a warm pale parchment studio wash.

Identity continuity: Brinen Jorai, age 23, gender presentation man, skin-value band 6; long narrow face; deep-set eyes and a heavy level brow; aquiline nose, softly full mouth; subtle age lines Preserve adult age cues, face geometry, skin, and expression; use a calm closed mouth with no smile or theatrical acting. Enlarge the cranium for chibi scale without replacing the source eye shape, eye spacing, brow structure, nose, mouth, jaw, or cheek planes with a shared generic doll-face template; the roster must retain visibly different adult faces at combat scale. Body continuity: clearly-muscular, short; 160 cm; clearly muscular construction with readable shoulders, back, legs, and forearms. Preserve shoulder and torso width, mass, softness, muscle distribution, upper-arm and forearm girth, wrist scale, hand size, leg mass, and posture. Do not make the arms, hands, shoulders, torso, or body fatter or bulkier merely because this is chibi. Tall or slight identity must read through shape and posture without shrinking the head below the required chibi ratio.

Hair continuity: dark-brown curls-coils-halo; accent: high gathered coil mass. Preserve the front and side silhouette of curls-coils-halo, the parting, gathered mass, shaved areas, and high gathered coil mass; color remains dark-brown. Wardrobe continuity: asymmetric-patchwork in plum-gray; intentional patchwork layers with an uneven hem, visible repairs, and practical trousers; low-profile toggles and articulated knee folds. Condition: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Preserve every visible seam, repair, closure, accessory, tattoo, marking, and palette relationship that survives at chibi scale. The sole reference is the exact candidate authorized by summon target brinen-jorai-summon-v1 and verified result brinen-jorai-summon-v1-result at assets/heroes/experiments/one-star-overnight-200-001/waves/wave-05/results/brinen-jorai/summon-v1.json; these identifiers are provenance only and must not appear in the image. findings.observation: Original-resolution inspection preserves the summon hero's mature 23-year-old adult identity: deep band-6 skin, long face, deep-set eyes, heavy level brow, aquiline nose, softly full closed mouth, subtle age lines, and calm stern expression remain recognizable rather than becoming a baby or generic doll face.

The chibi keeps Brinen's short clearly-muscular construction through compact height language, broad readable shoulders and back, narrow waist, developed legs, and source-coherent muscular mass without converting him into a soft or generically inflated body.

Both upper arms and forearms retain the summon portrait's pronounced muscular definition, with coherent wrists and two distinct empty fists; the strong hand scale remains consistent with the source's muscular construction and has no fusion or duplicate anatomy.
Dark-brown curls and coils preserve the source's dense halo, swept front construction, loose face-framing coils, and high gathered coil mass with no color, parting, or accent drift.

The plum-gray asymmetric patchwork, overlapping uneven hems, extensive visible repairs, simple closures, practical trousers, articulated patched knees, wraps, and boots remain source-faithful, and no tattoo, jewelry, or undeclared accessory appears. However, the source's single cloth-wrapped notebook is absent rather than visibly stowed while both hands are empty.

The complete high-coil hair-top-to-chin unit occupies approximately 45% of standing height, about 2.2 heads total. This is materially above the frozen 32-36% / 2.75-3.1-head range even though the bare cranium alone appears closer; the gate explicitly includes the full hair mass.

Exactly one coherent full-body subject appears with the entire high hair mass, head, both empty hands, all garment edges, both legs, both boots, and grounding shadow fully inside generous safe margins.
A broad staggered stance, bent compact limbs, lowered center of gravity, separated empty fists, forward three-quarter torso, and direct gaze create a clean grounded weaponless ready-idle silhouette.

The presentation remains repaired ordinary cloth, wraps, practical trousers, and worn boots on parchment, with no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect.
